parts.lifecycle_source: Littelfuse PDN EIC-1177 (2026-08-13): PCB SSR product family end of life, last-time buy 2026-11-11 https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/9033/PDN_EIC-1177.pdf ; affected-part attachment not obtained -- LAA110L coverage per Digi-Key Part Status 'Last Time Buy' (https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/ixys-integrated-circuits-division/LAA110L/LAA110L-ND/654928, seen via search snippet 2026-10-01)
parts.pages: p1 ordering/pinout, p2 specs, p5 MSL/soldering, p6 outline/land patterns (DIP, LS, PL)
parts.notes: Current-limited version of LAA110: load current limiting ILIM=+/-130mA min, 170mA typ, +/-210mA max @ VL=8V, IF=5mA. Pinout identical to LAA110 (datasheet p1 pin configuration): 1/2 = LED1 +/-, 3/4 = LED2 +/-, 8/7 = switch 1, 6/5 = switch 2; KiCad has no LAA110L symbol so Relay_SolidState:LAA110 is reused. Per-pole rating, mArms/mADC; derate if both poles operate (package dissipation 800mW). Input control current 50mA max, peak 1A (10ms); LED deactivate current 0.4mA min. Datasheet R12 (2021) lists UL94 V-0, but PCN EIC-1166 (2025-11-14) removes the V-0 rating for LAA110L/LS/PL. Newer revision DS-LAA110L-R13 exists on littelfuse.com but could not be downloaded (403, no Wayback capture). Lifecycle: Littelfuse product page Wayback capture 2026-06-09 shows Product Status Active (pre-PDN); PCN EIC-1159 (2025-10-01) listed all variants as continuing; Mouser/Digi-Key/octopart pages 403 to scripted fetch, so per-variant distributor status for LAA110LS/LAA110PL not confirmed directly. Footprint: datasheet 8-pin DIP, row spacing 7.62mm, pitch 2.54mm, hole pattern 0.762mm dia; KiCad DIP-8_W7.62mm has the same grid (0.8mm drill).

notes: littelfuse.com, Mouser, Digi-Key and octopart return 403 to scripted fetches. Datasheet DS-LAA110L-R12 came from a Wayback capture (2023-03-24) of the official ixysic.com PDF; the newest revision R13 (littelfuse.com assetguid fe0a8f9b-c618-4659-abb3-a77a8998ea36) has no Wayback capture.
Ordering info lists LAA110L (DIP), LAA110LS (surface mount), LAA110PL (flatpack) plus TR reels LAA110LSTR/LAA110PLTR; one row per package variant. There is no LAA110PLS or other variant.

PDN EIC-1177 (2026-08-13) attachment with the affected PN list was not obtainable; EOL for LAA110L rests on Digi-Key Part Status 'Last Time Buy' (search snippet) plus the PDN's family-wide scope. LAA110LS/LAA110PL assumed covered by the same family notice.
UL94 V-0 claim in R12 was withdrawn by PCN EIC-1166 (2025-11-14) for all LAA110L variants.
RoHS from Pb-free/RoHS/e3 logos on datasheet p1.
